metric: Overall: mean over the 200 documents of the mean of NID (reading order), TEDS (tables) and MHS (headings) where the ground truth defines them, 0–1; the benchmark's own scorers ported, on the Markdown body of oconv toMd read with pdfInfer: ['headings', 'tables'] (the opt-in inference of the untagged pdf path; no OCR; the profile-v1 front matter removed)
fidelity: the port reproduces 9874 of 9878 stored scores of 11 engines within 1e-9; 2 MHS higher where Python apted's distance is not the minimum (opendataloader-hybrid-hydrogen 01030000000181 (MHS 0.6190 vs 0.5795), unstructured 01030000000183 (MHS 0.0778 vs 0.0712))
